rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked the official docs, lista-dao GitHub org, and BSC search results. Six total artifacts catalogued: 4 contract addresses from the official smart-contract docs page (slisBNB, StakeManager, slisBNB on Ethereum, slisBNB OFTAdaptor), plus architecture identification of the lista-dao/lista-v3 DEX repo. DEX-specific deployed addresses (ListaV3Factory, SwapRouter, NonfungiblePositionManager proxy, ProxyAdmin) were not resolvable within the fetch budget — no broadcast/ artifacts or deployment manifests were accessible. grade=unknown because the primary DEX surface (factory, router, NPM) remains unaddressed.

evidence.shows: Lista DAO website confirms protocol operates on BSC and Ethereum, offers liquid staking (slisBNB), CDP stablecoin (lisUSD), and DEX/swap product. GitHub SHA 82cb98b7a771d528c61fb14018cc64ae7a679c5b embedded in meta tag.

Official Lista DAO developer docs list 4 deployed addresses: slisBNB token on BSC at 0xB0b84D294e0C75A6abe60171b70edEb2EFd14A1B, StakeManager on BSC at 0x1adB950d8bB3dA4bE104211D5AB038628e477fE6, slisBNB on Ethereum at 0x44388Ef3bc730BDE8670a3b4831281dd7E89C584, slisBNB OFTAdaptor on BSC at 0x82f5bcD1473BDa5794239D01073797093a413f02.

Lista V3 is a Uniswap V3 fork concentrated-liquidity DEX. Contracts include ListaV3Factory (non-upgradeable), ListaV3Pool (CREATE2, non-upgradeable), NonfungiblePositionManager (behind TransparentUpgradeableProxy with ProxyAdmin), SwapRouter, V3Migrator, Quoter, QuoterV2 (all non-upgradeable). No deployed addresses in README; audits/ folder exists. Deployment requires ProxyAdmin for NPM proxy.
Lista DAO GitHub org has 18 repositories including lista-v3 (DEX), lista-new-contracts, synclub-contracts, lista-token, lista-dao-contracts, lending-sdk. Confirms org identity.

Canonical docs site for Lista DAO on BSC. Navigation confirms Smart Lending & Swap, Audit Reports, Bug Bounty (Immunefi) sections exist. Lists Smart Swap as Lista's DEX product for concentrated liquidity.

protocol_metadata.about: Lista DAO is an open-source, permissionless CDP stablecoin and liquid staking protocol on BNB Chain and Ethereum, backed by Binance Lab. Users stake BNB to receive slisBNB (liquid staking receipt), then collateralise assets to borrow lisUSD (decentralized stablecoin). Lista DEX (Smart Swap) is a concentrated-liquidity AMM built as a Uniswap V3 fork (lista-v3), with the NonfungiblePositionManager deployed behind a TransparentUpgradeableProxy and the factory/pool/router deployed as non-upgradeable contracts. The protocol also offers Smart Lending, where LP collateral earns trading fees while being borrowed against.
